title: A Study of Eloralintide (LY3841136) in Participants With Obesity or Overweight, Type 2 Diabetes, and Increased Cardiovascular Risk
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Once-Weekly Eloralintide in Adult Participants With Obesity or Overweight, Type 2 Diabetes, and Increased CV Risk
summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of eloralintide compared with a placebo in participants with obesity or overweight, type 2 diabetes, and increased cardiovascular risk.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have type 2 diabetes
* Have a HbA1c value between ≥ 6.5% and ≤ 9.5% at screening
* Are on stable treatment with an unchanged dose of at least 1 and no more than 4 antihyperglycemic therapies for at least 90 days before screening
* Have an increased risk of cardiovascular events
* Have a BMI ≥ 25.0 kg/m2 at screening
* Have a stable body weight (\<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening
* Have a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to reduce body weight

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity (liposuction, cryolipolysis, or abdominoplasty allowed if performed \>1 year before screening)
* Have a prior or planned endoscopic procedure and/or device-based therapy for obesity (prior device-based therapy acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening)
* Have type 1 diabetes
* Have a history or diagnosis of New York Heart Association Functional Classification IV congestive heart failure
* Have had within 60 days prior to screening:

  * acute myocardial infarction
  * stroke
  * hospitalization for congestive heart failure, or
  * coronary, peripheral, or carotid artery revascularization procedure
* Have received treatment combining sulfonylurea and insulin within 90 days prior to screening
